system.effect:
Basic Combat Parts
Cost: +1 Complexity and $300
Effect: The Pokébot learns any two of the following Moves - @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.1Sk8xyD2S2J6qU1K]{Scratch}, @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.50Vtl0u0jPevwY4K]{Tackle}, @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.rmDcfFfrdq5PgwF9]{Take Down}, and @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.Y5R5mbVcGq6fwoFj]{Defense Curl}. A Pokébot may have this Part installed multiple times, choosing different Moves each time.

Basic Utility Parts
Cost: +1 Complexity and $300
Effect: Choose one of the following effects. A Pokébot may have this Part installed multiple times, choosing a different effect each time.

    The Pokébot gains +4 to all Movement Speeds
    The Pokébot gains the Levitate Ability and a Sky Speed of 2.
    The Pokébot gains a Swim speed equal to half its Overland speed.
    The Pokébot gains the @UUID[Compendium.ptu.capabilities.Item.a1N1M1GMjMClaOdj]{Stealth} and @UUID[Compendium.ptu.capabilities.Item.27U7ZioOgyZFzxDx]{Dead Silent} capabilities.

Advanced Combat Parts
Cost: +2 Complexity and $500
Effect: The Pokébot learns any two of the following Moves - @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.DzD1pun72sIQFQle]{Body Slam}, @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.sm3q5D8SkQcEmiGB]{Slash}, @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.4JCuFulwE1TXGhPW]{Lock-On}, and @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.TD9T2QEalKGQZicp]{Screech}. A Pokébot may have this Part installed multiple times, choosing different Moves each time.

Advanced Utility Parts
Cost: +2 Complexity and $500
Effect: Choose one of the following effects. A Pokébot may have this part installed multiple times,choosing a different effect each time.

    The Pokébot gains 3 Skill Ranks to distribute as you choose. You may select this option twice.
    The Pokébot gains a +4 bonus to its Power Capability
    The Pokébot gains the @UUID[Compendium.ptu.capabilities.Item.O00WEaCeKskK8vY4]{Magnetic} Capability and is immune to Scramble and EMP.

Sympathetic Drives
Cost: +2 Complexity
Effect: When creating a Sympathetic Drive, you must use a @UUID[Compendium.ptu.items.Item.PieOjJgJzqBWiGSR]{Magmarizer}, @UUID[Compendium.ptu.items.Item.62xEB88Z3MwgCT23]{Electirizer}, @UUID[Compendium.ptu.items.Item.Wt7PCOHdVHRaDklg]{Metal Coat}, @UUID[Compendium.ptu.items.Item.P9a4g2uek6ESUfBY]{Up-Grade}, or @UUID[Compendium.ptu.items.Item.DKZxxRaTueEU4kJF]{Dubious Disc}. A Pokébot may have multiple Sympathetic Drives installed, but no two that bestow the same effect. When installed, the Sympathetic Drive has an effect based on the item used to make it:

    Magmarizer - the Pokébot learns @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.EA2vavVCPlHFLvwf]{Fire Punch}, @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.m01FTVITfrqlu0Kn]{Flamethrower}, and @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.TiIjSQqYprGxlHAZ]{Fire Spin} OR the Pokébot gains @UUID[Compendium.ptu.abilities.Item.0EwtVaObxl7Rimhb]{Heatproof} and is immune to being Frozen.
    Electrizer - the Pokébot learns @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.0gi5EtY9Gq2yZ4eY]{Thunder Punch}, @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.0KazDGc9T8CETH5f]{Discharge}, and @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.N0EkteKIFV2WtAJ6]{Magnet Rise} OR the Pokébot gains @UUID[Compendium.ptu.abilities.Item.Tc5HA3VQmm66bgYc]{Motor Drive} and is immune to Paralysis.
    Metal Coat - the Pokébot learns @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.BGJbdXIYaUJJwOQN]{Iron Head}, @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.926T6mncd7CobCCr]{Flash Cannon}, and @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.K7oM1QaqyugwZzbF]{Iron Defense} OR the Pokébot is now Steel Type and ignores its base Pokébot type relations.
    Up-Grade - the Pokébot learns @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.IWDclyABMiQ3puo0]{Tri Attack}, @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.uQ8GRD9yi4beR4PP]{Conversion} and @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.wxMkDV7tasspdddy]{Thunder Wave} OR the Pokébot gains @UUID[Compendium.ptu.abilities.Item.2QcBRFuNlyFtyeI8]{Download} and @UUID[Compendium.ptu.abilities.Item.BmvqFZyTXoO12Gik]{Analytic}.
    Dubious Disc - the Pokébot learns @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.9aU7CnwwaU0FE4tk]{Metronome}, @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.iQXpUEYL3sawCfvM]{Acupressure}, and @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.Ma0Yb0fLx263208P]{Disable} OR the Pokébot gains @UUID[Compendium.ptu.abilities.Item.G0Y7SqRMddqfOU3Z]{Moody} and may be healed by Restoratives, Refreshments, and Moves.

Repair Nanites
Cost: +2 Complexity and $1000
Effect: The Pokébot gains the @UUID[Compendium.ptu.abilities.Item.eIl3V6VvOoYYiIAJ]{Regenerator} Ability. Additionally, once per day, as an Extended Action it may gain a Digestion Buff as if using @UUID[Compendium.ptu.items.Item.gKLH9MtGnLh0OPR4]{Leftovers}.

Wired Compatibility Core
Cost: +3 Complexity and $2000
Effect: When installed, choose up to two of the Pokébot’s Moves and one of its Abilities. Whenever a Pokemon with @UUID[Compendium.ptu.capabilities.Item.qL3NoxglZIBtFB1r]{Wired} is controlling this Pokébot, it adds the chosen Moves to its Movelist and gains the chosen Ability. While being controlled, a Pokébot loses access to its other Moves. Rotom inhabiting this Pokébot are treated as if in Appliance Form.
